summary: Comprehensive testing of UNIFIED GST SCHEMA implementation for midconnect B2B marketplace. All 12 backend tests pass (100%). Frontend code review confirms AuthContext exposes gstStatus and sellerStatus, and seller dashboard includes all required status banners with data-testid attributes.

Backend /api/admin/stats uses roles='seller' query for sellers count
Backend /api/admin/stats uses gst.status='pending' query for pending GST count
Backend /api/admin/stats subscription counts use roles='seller' query
Backend /api/admin/users/{id}/verify-gst endpoint exists and handles invalid IDs correctly
Backend seller listing creation checks GST verification
Frontend AuthContext exposes gstStatus with type 'none' | 'pending' | 'verified' | 'rejected'
Frontend AuthContext exposes sellerStatus with type 'active' | 'suspended' | 'banned'
Frontend seller/page.tsx has gst-pending-banner with data-testid
Frontend seller/page.tsx has gst-rejected-banner with data-testid
Frontend seller/page.tsx has seller-banned-banner with data-testid
Frontend seller/page.tsx has seller-suspended-banner with data-testid

require_gst_verified_seller (lines 2075-2117) correctly checks gst.status='verified', not gst.verified
Banned/suspended seller blocking implemented in require_gst_verified_seller (lines 2094-2105)
Frontend AuthContext (lines 292-295) derives gstStatus from profile?.gst?.status
All seller dashboard banners have proper data-testid attributes for testing
